mana_ring.description: Adds 20 maximum Focus while worn. Does not fill the additional capacity.

silver_ring.description: Adds 5 maximum Focus while worn. Does not fill the additional capacity.

cooldown_ring.description: Reduces spellbook cooldowns by fifteen percent, with diminishing returns above fifty percent.

cast_time_ring.description: Reduces spellbook cast times by fifteen percent, with diminishing returns above fifty percent.

heavy_chain_necklace.description: Reduces incoming magic damage by fifteen percent.

emerald_stoneplate_ring.description: Defeated creatures drop twenty-five percent more experience.

fireward_ring.description: Prevents fire damage and extinguishes the wearer.

poisonward_ring.description: Prevents poison; existing poison is removed while worn.

conjurers_talisman.description: Your summoned defenders deal fifteen percent more damage.

greater_conjurers_talisman.description: Your summoned defenders deal fifteen percent more damage. Natural summon time-outs do not trigger recast cooldowns.

affinity_ring.description: Adds one level to the attuned spell. Use with a supported scroll in the other hand to consume it and attune the ring.

concentration_amulet.description: Damage cannot interrupt your long spell casts.

lurker_ring.description: While invisible, your next hit deals fifty percent extra damage. Fifteen-second cooldown.

amethyst_resonance_charm.description: Regenerate shared Focus fifteen percent faster while worn.

invisibility_ring.description: Reveals invisible creatures to you. Does not make you invisible.

expulsion_ring.description: Being hurt pushes permitted enemies within four blocks away. Two-second cooldown; does not break blocks.

teleportation_amulet.description: A successful spell teleport grants one Evasion hit for three seconds.

betrayer_signet.description: Ten percent eldritch spell power. Hits against players with extra Focus capacity gain diminishing bonus damage, once per five seconds.

wicked_bone_ring.description: Compatible spell projectiles can ricochet one additional time.
